candidates.requirement: Build stream_round_trip with at least one supported compressor-exclusion configuration so its streaming round trip can exercise the new strategy fallback and conditional compressor selection.
candidates.target_route: The supplied recipe invokes fuzz.py build all. The stream_round_trip target links the compression library and calls ZSTD_compressStream2 after choosing random compression parameters.
candidates.failure_condition: Both exclusion options default to zero. The supplied build invocation enables neither, so fuzz input cannot activate the exclusion-dependent branches.
candidates.alternative_paths: Random strategy selection exercises ordinary compressors, but cannot define compile-time exclusion macros. Other tests and targets do not exercise this target under an exclusion build.
